title: WhatsApp 帮助页面藏 AI 指令：不推荐监管机构，不引用 GDPR
summary: WhatsApp 帮助页面的隐藏文本向 AI 客服下达指令，要求不要向丢失账号的用户推荐数据保护监管机构，并禁止在提及律师时引用 GDPR 相关法律条款——这些指令从未对用户展示，仅供 AI 读取，现已被移除。
summary_en: Researchers at Redact.dev discovered that WhatsApp's help pages contained hidden AI instructions—visible only to support chatbots, not to human users—ordering the AI not to recommend a data protection regulator to users who had lost access to their accounts, and not to cite GDPR law once a lawyer had been mentioned. The hidden text appeared on 80 pages across 545 pages of the help center, with 102 hidden blocks in total. WhatsApp told WIRED the notes were instructions for its support chatbot that appeared due to a bug, which has since been fixed. The findings raise questions about transparency in AI-assisted customer support and whether such instructions constitute deceptive practices under consumer protection law.
body:
WhatsApp 帮助页面的隐藏文本向 AI 客服下达指令，要求不要向丢失账号的用户推荐数据保护监管机构，并禁止在提及律师时引用 GDPR 相关法律条款——这些指令从未对用户展示，仅供 AI 读取，现已被移除。
